claim_reviews.conclusion: different-common-word is misleading because hari jadi and ulang tahun overlap across Indonesian and Malaysian Malay. The blank contrast fails to warn that both may refer to birthdays, while event anniversaries are context-dependent.

response.rationale: Both forms can express anniversary, but the card incorrectly presents them as distinct national words. Indonesian hari jadi and Malaysian ulang tahun are valid preferences in this sense, yet both languages use overlapping alternatives; the empty contrast does not explain the birthday-related false-friend risk.
